title: Zoomies
tagline: Every robot vacuum in the house wants your fur. Make them bonk.
teaser: You are the hairiest thing in the house, and every robot vacuum is coming for you, one square a turn. You cannot fight them, only move: stand where two arrive together and they bonk. Twelve rooms, a daily mess, the 1980 original and the cats next door, who play every room too.

manPage.synopsis: zoomies — step, loaf or zoom, and make the robot vacuums bump into each other.
manPage.description: A reborn robots, the turn-based chase Ken Arnold wrote for BSD Unix. Every vacuum rolls straight at the cat after each move; two on one square tangle for good. The rival cats play strategies found in the original's source: two hidden experiments and the automatic player added in 1999.

howToPlay: Step one square at a time; after every step each vacuum rolls one square toward you.
Stand where two vacuums arrive together and they bonk into a tangle that traps the rest.
Loaf to let them come to you, zoom when you are cornered, and tidy every room.
